render_probe.gd.source:
extends SceneTree
const Snapshot=preload("res://scripts/progression/run_snapshot.gd")
const Supplies=preload("res://tests/test_supplies.gd")
const Textures=preload("res://tests/test_portrait_reactions.gd")
const FOLDER:="res://.local_validation/GAME054/render-live"
var ui
var errors:Array=[]
var records:Array=[]
var mouse_controls:=0
func expect(ok:bool,label:String):
 if not ok:errors.append(label)
func _initialize():call_deferred("run")
func touch(id:int,at:Vector2,pressed:bool,canceled:bool=false):
 var event:=InputEventScreenTouch.new()
 event.index=id
 event.position=at
 event.pressed=pressed
 event.canceled=canceled
 Input.parse_input_event(event)
func click(control:Control):
 mouse_controls+=1
 await process_frame
 await process_frame
 if ui._scroll.is_ancestor_of(control):ui._scroll.ensure_control_visible(control)
 await process_frame
 await process_frame
 var at:Vector2=control.get_global_rect().get_center()
 var motion:=InputEventMouseMotion.new()
 motion.position=at
 Input.parse_input_event(motion)
 var event:=InputEventMouseButton.new()
 event.button_index=MOUSE_BUTTON_LEFT
 event.position=at
 event.pressed=true
 Input.parse_input_event(event)
 await process_frame
 event=event.duplicate()
 event.pressed=false
 Input.parse_input_event(event)
 await process_frame
func resize(size:Vector2i,inset:float=0):
 root.content_scale_mode=Window.CONTENT_SCALE_MODE_DISABLED
 root.content_scale_size=size
 root.size=size
 DisplayServer.window_set_size(size)
 ui.root_ui.set_anchors_and_offsets_preset(Control.PRESET_FULL_RECT)
 ui.root_ui.size=Vector2(size)
 ui.safe_area_override=Rect2(Vector2(inset,6),Vector2(size)-Vector2(inset*2,18))
 ui._apply_layout()
 await process_frame
 await process_frame
 ui._apply_layout()
func capture(tag:String):
 ui._update_hud();ui.view.queue_redraw()
 var state:Dictionary=Snapshot.capture(ui.simulation);var clocks:Dictionary=ui.simulation.feedback.clocks.duplicate(true)
 await process_frame;await process_frame;await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
 expect(root.get_texture().get_image().save_png(FOLDER.path_join(tag+".png"))==OK,"capture "+tag)
 expect(Snapshot.capture(ui.simulation)==state and ui.simulation.feedback.clocks==clocks,"render read only "+tag)
 records.append({"tag":tag,"expression":ui.feedback_panel.expression_key,"feedback":ui.feedback_panel.state_key,"art_visible":ui.feedback_panel.portrait.visible,"exact_art":ui.feedback_panel.expression_has_art,"danger":ui.feedback_panel.danger_text.text,"phase":ui.simulation.phase,"hp":ui.simulation.hp,"viewport":str(root.size)})
func step(count:int):
 for i in range(count):ui._physics_process(.05);await process_frame
func hp_item():
 var item:Dictionary=Supplies.drop(ui.simulation,"hp");item.p=ui.simulation.player;ui._physics_process(.01)
func run():
 DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(FOLDER)
 ui=load("res://scenes/main.tscn").instantiate()
 ui.run_store.path=FOLDER.path_join("battle.save");ui.gold_progress.path=FOLDER.path_join("gold.cfg");ui.settings_path=FOLDER.path_join("settings.cfg")
 for path in [ui.run_store.path,ui.gold_progress.path,ui.settings_path]:DirAccess.remove_absolute(path)
 root.add_child(ui);ui.set_physics_process(false);await process_frame;await resize(Vector2i(1280,720))
 await click(ui.start_button);await click(ui.stage_launch_button)
 var s=ui.simulation
 s.spawn_clock=999;s.shot_clock=999;s._scatter_clock=999;s._swarm_clock=999
 expect(s.has_active_run() and not ui.feedback_panel.portrait.visible,"real sortie uses prepared empty portrait slot")
 await capture("normal")
 expect(s.damage_player(15),"accepted real damage")
 ui._physics_process(.01)
 expect(ui.feedback_panel.expression_key=="hurt","actual HUD pain expression")
 await capture("hurt")
 hp_item()
 expect(ui.feedback_panel.expression_key=="hurt" and s.feedback.clocks.heal==1,"HP supply queues recovery behind pain")
 await step(12)
 expect(ui.feedback_panel.expression_key=="heal","recovery appears after higher-priority hurt")
 await capture("heal")
 ui.pause_game();expect(ui.battle_save_error==OK,"actual portrait reaction does not corrupt atomic battle save")
 var before:Dictionary=s.feedback.clocks.duplicate(true)
 for i in range(10):ui._physics_process(.05);await process_frame
 expect(s.feedback.clocks==before,"native pause freezes portrait clocks")
 expect(DirAccess.copy_absolute(ui.run_store.path,FOLDER.path_join("healing.save"))==OK,"retain transient-recovery save")
 await click(ui.resume_button);await step(24)
 s.add_pickup(s.player,s.growth.threshold());ui._physics_process(.01)
 expect(s.phase==s.Phase.CHOOSING and ui.feedback_panel.expression_key=="levelup","actual XP pickup and modal select joy expression")
 await capture("levelup")
 before=s.feedback.clocks.duplicate(true)
 for i in range(4):ui._physics_process(.05)
 expect(before==s.feedback.clocks,"choice preserves joy timer and offer")
 while s.phase==s.Phase.CHOOSING:
  await click(ui.choice_buttons[0]);ui._physics_process(.01)
 await step(26)
 s.hurt_clock=0;s.damage_player(s.hp-20);ui._physics_process(.01)
 expect(ui.feedback_panel.expression_key=="hurt" and not ui.feedback_panel.danger_text.text.is_empty(),"low HP warning remains visible with pain")
 await capture("low_hp")
 await step(12)
 expect(ui.feedback_panel.expression_key=="normal" and not ui.feedback_panel.danger_text.text.is_empty(),"low HP does not invent a fifth expression")
 await resize(Vector2i(960,540),12);hp_item();await capture("compact_heal")
 # Existing design hook only: no poison map/damage mechanic is fabricated.
 s.feedback.set_persistent_pain(true);ui._physics_process(.01);await capture("persistent_pain")
 s.feedback.set_persistent_pain(false)
 # Temporary flat QA textures prove the actual same widget's binding;not shipped art.
 var folder:="res://".path_join(".godot").path_join("portrait-gui-"+Crypto.new().generate_random_bytes(8).hex_encode())
 DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(folder)
 var colors:Array=[Color.RED,Color.BLUE,Color.GREEN,Color.YELLOW]
 var keys:Array=ui.feedback_panel.portrait_assets.EXPRESSIONS
 for i in range(keys.size()):
  var path:String=folder.path_join(keys[i]+".tres");expect(ResourceSaver.save(Textures.texture(colors[i]),path)==OK,"save QA texture")
  ui.feedback_panel.portrait_assets.definitions[keys[i]]=path
 var switched:=true
 for key in keys:
  s.feedback.reset()
  if key!="normal":s.feedback.trigger(key)
  ui._update_hud();await process_frame;await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
  switched=switched and ui.feedback_panel.expression_key==key and ui.feedback_panel.expression_has_art and ui.feedback_panel.portrait.visible and ui.feedback_panel.portrait.texture.resource_path==ui.feedback_panel.portrait_assets.definitions[key]
 expect(switched,"all four textures switch in actual combat panel at compact size")
 expect(ui.feedback_panel.portrait.mouse_filter==Control.MOUSE_FILTER_IGNORE,"portrait image cannot capture joystick input")
 ui.feedback_panel.portrait_assets.definitions={"normal":"","hurt":"","heal":"","levelup":""};s.feedback.reset();ui._update_hud()
 await resize(Vector2i(1280,720))
 var center:Vector2=ui.movement.get_global_transform_with_canvas()*ui.layout_data.move.get_center()
 touch(4,center,true);await process_frame
 var drag:=InputEventScreenDrag.new();drag.index=4;drag.position=center+Vector2(0,60);Input.parse_input_event(drag)
 var start:Vector2=s.player;await step(20);touch(4,center,false)
 expect(s.player.distance_to(start)>20,"portrait prepared system preserves actual native touch movement")
 var result:Dictionary={"status":"PASS" if errors.is_empty() else "FAIL","errors":errors,"screens":records,"four_texture_switches":switched,"texture_fixtures":"Temporary flat QA only;shipped four and existing53paths remain empty.","mouse_controls":mouse_controls,"schema":Snapshot.VERSION,"fingerprint":Snapshot.fingerprint()}
 var f=FileAccess.open(FOLDER.path_join("report.json"),FileAccess.WRITE);f.store_string(JSON.stringify(result,"  "));f.close();print(JSON.stringify(result))
 ui.queue_free();await process_frame
 for path in DirAccess.get_files_at(folder):DirAccess.remove_absolute(folder.path_join(path))
 DirAccess.remove_absolute(folder)
 await create_timer(.1).timeout;quit(0 if errors.is_empty() else 1)
